function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a city.

function.name: get_stock_price
function.description: Get the latest stock price for a ticker symbol.

trigger_prompts: What's the weather like in Tokyo right now?
Is it cold in Reykjavik today? Please check.
Tell me the current temperature in Nairobi in celsius.
What is the latest price of the stock AAPL?
How much is MSFT trading at right now?
Look up the current share price for TSLA.
Use the calculator to add 1234.5 and 876.25.
Please add 17 and 25 for me with the tool.
Check the weather in Lima, in fahrenheit.
What does NVDA cost at the moment?
plain_prompts: Write a haiku about autumn rain.
What is the capital of Australia?
Explain what a prime number is in one sentence.
Give me a synonym for the word happy.
What is the boiling point of water at sea level in Celsius, from memory?
Write one sentence about the moon.
Who wrote the novel Pride and Prejudice?
Summarize the plot of Cinderella in one sentence.
What is 2 plus 2, answer from memory?
Suggest a name for a pet goldfish.
json_instruction:
Extract the person from the text and respond with a JSON object with keys name (string), age (integer) and city (string) and nothing else.

Text:

Our new colleague, Chen Wei, 29, just moved to Singapore.
Amara Okafor (41) runs a bakery in Lagos.
Located in Oslo, Henrik Solberg turned 57 last week.
